content.text:
**Finding: missing (critical) — no indemnification provision exists in the Agreement.**

Investigation summary:
- Searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless" and "defend" returned no results; the sole infringement reference (p0046) is a mutual advertising-content covenant, not risk allocation.
- Section 9 (Warranties) covers only corporate authority reps and the Globix carve-out; Section 10 (General Provisions) has no indemnity or liability terms. There is no limitation-of-liability section either, so no existing risk-allocation bargain to respect.
- Result: no HDI IP indemnity for the Site it develops and hosts, and no coverage for HDI's breach of law, data incidents or gross negligence/wilful misconduct — walk-away territory.

Redline (validated ok:true) inserts the vendor indemnity as new Section 9(c) with a standard notice/control/cooperation procedure at 9(e), and a deliberately narrow Company indemnity at 9(d) limited to Company-supplied Content/Marks and our own breach of law. Placing it within Section 9 also brings it inside the existing Section 10.7 survival list, and the heading is updated to "Warranties; Indemnification."
